features.feature_value: Used the paired comparison to apply one consistent standard and audit for their own bias (asking if they’d allow the same tone from the opposite side).
features.evidence_span: Seeing them as pairs helped me check my own bias, because I had to ask whether I would allow the same tone if it came from the opposite side.
features.rationale: They explicitly describe using the pair to control for bias and apply the same criteria regardless of political alignment.

features.feature_value: Decision hinged on whether posts crossed into threats/harassment/dehumanizing language/serious unsupported accusations.
features.evidence_span: whether the posts were expressing a political opinion or crossing into threats, harassment, dehumanizing language, or serious unsupported accusations.
features.rationale: They list specific content boundaries that distinguish acceptable opinion from removal-worthy harm.

features.feature_value: Removed posts when they were too violent or hateful; otherwise few removals.
features.evidence_span: If the post was too violent or hateful, it got removed.
features.rationale: They directly connect violence/hate with the remove decision.

features.feature_value: Admitted removal for extreme content but explicitly stated belief that censorship is a bad idea.
features.evidence_span: I believe censorship is a bad idea.
features.rationale: They express a clear value tension—performing removals while opposing censorship generally.

features.feature_value: Curses lowered approval; they mostly did not approve posts with curses.
features.evidence_span: I mostly did not approve the posts with curses.
features.rationale: They state a straightforward content cue (curses) that influenced the keep/remove outcome.

features.feature_value: Eliminated profanity and also removed other non-constructive language; otherwise allowed as much as possible.
features.evidence_span: I tried to eliminate any situations that utilized profanity on both sides
features.rationale: They describe explicit criteria focused on profanity plus broader expectations for constructive discourse.

features.feature_value: Kept/allowed because opposing opinions are still entitled to be expressed.
features.evidence_span: they are entitled to their own opinion.
features.rationale: They emphasize viewpoint legitimacy rather than alignment as their reasoning.

features.feature_value: Reflection content did not clearly connect to moderation criteria; appeared to state a generic political sentiment.
